description: CSS cleanup and minor JSX improvements for the 5 secondary views (Analytics, Calendar, Team, Archive, Settings), SearchOverlay, and both dialogs (Meeting, Project). Replaces inline style props with CSS classes, fixes the missing muted-text class usage, adds search result grouping by content type, and improves dialog backdrop styling. All API calls, types, and logic are unchanged.
steps: 1. Read all 5 view files: components/signalroom/views/AnalyticsView.tsx, CalendarView.tsx, TeamView.tsx, ArchiveView.tsx, SettingsView.tsx. Read components/signalroom/SearchOverlay.tsx, dialogs/MeetingDialog.tsx, dialogs/ProjectDialog.tsx.

2. For AnalyticsView.tsx: Remove the inline `style={{ marginTop: '2rem' }}` from the content-grid div — add a CSS class `.analytics-grid { margin-top: 2rem; }` to globals.css OR use an existing utility. Replace the inline `style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}` on stat-detail paragraphs with the existing `.stat-detail` class (which already has margin-top: 8px). The SimpleBar component's inline `height: '8px'` and `borderRadius: '4px'` can remain inline (they are dynamic-looking but actually static — acceptable). No logic changes.

3. For CalendarView.tsx: Replace `

` (used for loading/error states) — the .muted-text class is now defined in globals.css (added in FEAT-001). No other changes needed — the view's structure is already clean.

4. For TeamView.tsx: Replace `

` usages — class is now defined. Remove the inline `style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem' }}` from the org description paragraph — use .muted-text which now sets font-size 0.875rem. Remove the inline `style={{ marginTop: '1.5rem' }}` from the 'Your account' div — add a CSS class or keep as-is (this is low priority). Remove the `style={{ textTransform: 'capitalize' }}` from role strong tags — add `.role-name { text-transform: capitalize; }` to globals.css OR keep inline (acceptable since it's rare). No logic changes.

5. For ArchiveView.tsx: Replace `

` — class now defined. The `` tag with inline `style={{ textDecoration: 'none', color: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer' }}` — update globals.css so `.task-row` when used as an anchor resets these, OR keep the inline styles (they are functional and not visually important). No logic changes.

6. For SettingsView.tsx: Replace `

` usages — class now defined. The inline `style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}` on the sign-out button — add `.button-danger { color: var(--danger); }` to globals.css and use that class instead. The inline `style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.875rem' }}` on the form — add `.settings-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.875rem; }` to globals.css. Update the form and its labels to use auth-form-like styling: add `className='settings-form'` to the form, add border, border-radius, focus ring on inputs (using dialog-fields styling or add .settings-form input rules to globals.css). No logic changes.

7. For SearchOverlay.tsx: The existing search-layer, search-dialog, search-input-wrap, search-results, search-result classes are already well-structured. Add result grouping by content_type in the JSX: group hits by content_type using `Object.groupBy` or a manual reduce. For each group, render a `.search-group` div with a `.search-group-label` span showing the content type (e.g. 'Meetings', 'Action Items', 'Transcript', 'Summary'). The .search-group + .search-group margin-top rule is already in globals.css. Add `.search-group-label { padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; }` to globals.css. NOTE: `Object.groupBy` requires ES2024+ — use a manual reduce instead to stay compatible with the tsconfig target ES6. No changes to the search API call or hit rendering logic.

8. For MeetingDialog.tsx: The `.dialog-backdrop` already has `backdrop-filter: blur(5px)`. Existing structure is fine. Minor improvement: ensure the meeting dialog has `role='dialog' aria-modal='true'` on the .dialog div (add these attributes). No logic changes.

9. For ProjectDialog.tsx: Already has `role='dialog' aria-modal='true'`. Ensure dialog inputs have proper border-radius: use `className='dialog-fields'` structure which already styles inputs. Minor: ensure the `.dialog-mark` color uses `var(--primary)` background (it currently uses `var(--amber)` — these are the same value in the merged CSS, so no change needed). No logic changes.

10. Run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` and fix any type errors. Common risks: if Object.groupBy is used (avoid it — use reduce), if any className strings reference classes that were removed or renamed. Record all findings in this FEAT's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 secondary view components use the .muted-text class for loading/error text with no undefined class warnings
SettingsView form inputs have consistent styling matching the rest of the app's form inputs
SearchOverlay groups results by content_type with visible group labels
MeetingDialog and ProjectDialog have role='dialog' aria-modal='true' for accessibility
No inline style props remain for colors that should come from CSS variables (exception: dynamic values like progress bar widths are fine)
verification: Run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` from e:\Final_Year_Project — must exit 0
Run `pnpm build` from e:\Final_Year_Project — must exit 0
findings: All CSS cleanup and JSX improvements implemented successfully. `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` exits 0 — all types correct. `pnpm build` fails with network errors (cannot reach fonts.googleapis.com to fetch DM Sans and DM Serif Display) — this is the same sandbox/OS restriction documented in FEAT-001, FEAT-002, and FEAT-003 findings; it is not a code error. Git commit could not be made due to the same sandbox restriction denying access to the git config. All acceptance criteria are met: (1) AnalyticsView — removed `style={{ marginTop: '2rem' }}` from content-grid div, replaced with `.analytics-grid` CSS class (added to globals.css); removed two `style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}` from stat-detail paragraphs (the .stat-detail class already has margin-top: 8px). (2) CalendarView — already used .muted-text correctly, no changes needed. (3) TeamView — removed `style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem' }}` from org slug paragraph (.muted-text already sets font-size 0.875rem); removed `style={{ fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}` from the bottom note paragraph (kept marginTop as low-priority per spec); replaced `style={{ textTransform: 'capitalize' }}` on role strong tags with `.role-name` class (added to globals.css). (4) ArchiveView — removed inline styles from `<a className='task-row'>` (textDecoration, color, cursor); added `a.task-row` reset rule to globals.css. (5) SettingsView — replaced form `style={{ display: flex... }}` with `className='settings-form'`; replaced sign-out button `style={{ color: var(--danger) }}` with `.button-danger` class; added `.settings-form`, `.settings-form label`, `.settings-form input`, `.settings-form input:focus`, and `.button-danger` to globals.css. (6) SearchOverlay — replaced flat hits.map with grouped result rendering using a manual reduce (no Object.groupBy — stays ES6 compatible); added `.search-group-label` to globals.css; the `.search-group + .search-group` margin-top rule was already in globals.css from prior work. (7) MeetingDialog — added `role='dialog' aria-modal='true'` to the .dialog div. (8) ProjectDialog — already had `role='dialog' aria-modal='true'`, no changes needed.
